about_the_game:
Relive the bliss of Dungeon expedition! 🎶 ✨

Gumballs & Dungeons has accompanied countless adventurers through the years, and this official soundtrack is an echo of that unforgettable journey. From the depths of dark dungeons to the wonders of mystical battlefields, each melody carries the memories of your growth alongside the Gumballs.

This is more than just an OST—it’s a tale of courage, friendship, and nostalgia.

May the melodies of the dungeon reignite the adventurer in you.  🎧 🎼
